resources.string: Unkent Live Photo format (no a Google/OPPO/vivo/Xiaomi/Apple Live Photo)
The cover photo is missin or tuim
The video is missin or tuim
The video is ower muckle (%1$dMB); a Live Photo cannae be composed. Pick a shorter video
The transcoded video is ower muckle (%1$dMB); a Live Photo cannae be composed
The video is ower muckle (%1$dMB); a Live Photo cannae be composed
The cover is a HEIC image (the licht version disnae transcode; export it as JPEG on the iPhone, then convert)
The cover is no a valid image (HEIC needs HEIF decodin bi the seestem)
The cover is no a JPEG image (the licht version disnae transcode; uise a JPEG photo)
The cover is no a valid image (only JPEG/WebP/PNG)

The video «%1$s» %2$s; chyngin only the container (remuxin) cannae chynge the codec, sae a Live Photo cannae be composed.\n\nIn "Settins → Video transcodin → Transcodin mode" pick "Re-encode", or convert it tae an H.264/H.265 MP4 wi anither tool first.

The video is no in a staunart MP4 container (MOV / MKV / WebM / AVI etc.), an the current "Transcodin mode" disnae re-encode, sae a Live Photo cannae be composed.\n\nIn "Settins → Video transcodin → Transcodin mode" pick "Re-encode" (the staunart version bundles an ffmpeg encoder; the licht Go version haes nae transcoder, sae uise the staunart version), or convert the video tae a staunart MP4 (H.264/H.265) first.
The soorce an target formats is the same; copied as-is (nae loss)
The soorce video haes non-audio/video tracks (%1$s); same-format passthrou wis skipped an the full write path wis uised tae sanitise
The soorce haes nae cover-frame timestamp; per the spec the midpoint o the video wis uised
The video haes extra tracks (%1$s) that cannae be sanitised; ootput as-is (on some devices the result may no play on a lang press)
Soorce video %1$s; remuxin the container alane cannae fix it (%2$s). Gin the result still disnae play on a lang press, pick "Re-encode" in "Settins → Video transcodin → Transcodin mode"
Soorce video %1$s; re-encoded tae 8-bit + AAC as set tae improve gallerie compatibility
The re-encode result is nae mair uiseable; ootput as-is (on some devices the result may no play on a lang press)
Re-encodin failed (%1$s); ootput as-is (on some devices the result may no play on a lang press)
The cover wis HEIC (no JPEG); transcoded tae a staunart JPEG afore packagin
Transcoder no enabled: only the container brand is rewritten (MOV → MP4), wi nae re-encodin
Transcodin the video tae staunart MP4 wi ffmpeg (%1$s / crf %2$d / %3$s; keepin only the video an audio tracks)
Remuxin the video container tae staunart MP4 (container only, nae re-encodin)

The selectit video is langer nor 3 seconds, sae the composed Live Photo may hae compatibility problems:

• it may no play richt
• it may no be recognessed bi the seestem gallerie
• some devices may no recogness this Live Photo
An auld version (Go) o the app is still instawed on this device. That version nae langer warks here; ye can uninstall it tae free up space.

Replace mode writes the conversion result straucht back tae the oreeginal files; ance owerwritten, the oreeginals cannae be fund again.

• Gin the app is interruptit, the storage rins oot, or the permeession is taen back while writin, the soorce files may be corruptit
• Nae conversion is guaranteed tae succeed, an on failure the soorce files may already be uiseable nae mair
• Try ane or twae files first tae mak shuir awthing is fine afore processin in bulk
• Mak yer ain backup o important photos first

This feature is gien "as is"; ye uise it at yer ain risk, an the author is no liable fur corruptit or tint files.
